properties.title: Marelli Automotive Lighting Files for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
properties.summary: Marelli Automotive Lighting USA LLC and 75 affiliated companies, including Marelli North America, Inc., have filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the District of Delaware on June 11, 2025. This significant move indicates a major restructuring effort within the company, as detailed in the bankruptcy petitions signed by authorized signatory Marisa Iasenza.

properties.title: Marelli Automotive Lighting Files for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
properties.summary: Marelli Automotive Lighting USA LLC and 75 affiliates have filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, citing severe financial difficulties and significant liabilities. The filing, which took place on June 11, 2025, includes a list of major unsecured creditors, with Stellantis, Nissan, and Bosch Group among those owed substantial debts.

properties.title: Marelli North America Initiates Chapter 11 Bankruptcy for Debt Restructuring
properties.summary: Marelli North America, Inc. has initiated voluntary Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings in Delaware, aiming to restructure its debt. The company secured a significant $865 million super-senior DIP facility, with interim approval to access $519 million immediately, following support from approximately 80% of its lenders.

properties.title: Marelli North America Files for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Amid Tariff Struggles
properties.summary: Marelli North America, a key automotive supplier, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, citing significant financial strain from increasing tariffs that have impacted its business model. The company owes over $453 million to Stellantis and $313 million to Nissan, but has secured $519 million in debtor-in-possession financing to aid in its restructuring efforts. Despite the bankruptcy, Marelli's leadership assures that no layoffs are planned, and major clients like Nissan are supportive of the company's recovery process.
